## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```
## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.'

```{r}
install.packages(c("sf", "tmap", "tmaptools", "RSQLite", "tidyverse"), 
                 repos = "https://www.stats.bris.ac.uk/R/")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
mycsv <- read_csv("week1/fly-tipping-borough_updated.csv", skip = 1)
```
```{r}
library(sf)

shape <- st_read("week1/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/ESRI/London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp")
```
```{r}
summary(shape)
```
```{r}
plot(shape)
```
```{r}
library(sf)
shape %>%
  st_geometry() %>%
  plot()
```
```{r}
shape2 <- shape%>%
  merge(.,
        mycsv,
        by.x="GSS_CODE",
        by.y="Row Labels")
```

```{r}
shape2%>%
  head(., n=10)
```
```{r}
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")
# change the fill to your column name if different
shape2 %>%
  qtm(.,fill = "2024-25")
```
```{r}
shape%>% st_write(.,
  "week1/flytipping.gpkg",
  layer = "london_boroughs_fly_tipping",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
library(readr)
library(RSQLite)

con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),dbname="week1/flytipping.gpkg")
```

```{r}
con %>%
  dbListTables()
```
```{r}
con %>%
  dbWriteTable(.,
               "original_csv",
               mycsv,
               overwrite=TRUE)

con %>% 
  dbDisconnect()
```
